thread_title: S. flava var. rubricorpora 'black throat' Liberty Co, FL
breadcrumb: S. flava var. rubricorpora 'black throat' Liberty Co, FL

posts.body_html: Here's a clone you don't see every day(Well, there's actually 3 black throated plants in this tray, probably all siblings). The throat on this thing is almost completely black!!!! There are other plants in the exact same tray, same soil, and mostly same environment are showing regular red throats, which is important because if all the plants in this tray showed black throats, either they're all siblings or something in the environment is triggering this color. Some of you received divisions of this exact plant before I knew it was a gem, so you guys are lucky! Photos taken 5/23/18:
